items: Implement one loop end-to-end against a real fixture repo / problem: the deterministic families first (`build_repo_index`, `apply_patch`, `run_tests`) with FixtureTransport-style sandboxing, so they earn execution receipts and move from candidate to source-backed.
Stand up the benchmark harness (arms above) with the run-checker honesty gates -- PlanLock per attempt, ExecutionReceipt per step, no simulated baselines.
Add `primitive_template` skeletons for the CP `SolutionTemplate` catalog and wire `select_solution_template` to the `prim:algo.*` kernels by `AlgorithmPattern`.
Mine real coding-agent and CP-template repos through the repo-mining factory (`docs/codex/repo-mining-factory-spec.md`) to attach source refs to these candidate families.
`table_line_item_extract` real implementation (invoice / rent schedule / division-order tables) with cell-span grounding - the DocILE LIR track.

Format ingest adapters: real PDF (native + OCR), DOCX, HTML - each an injectable transport like the place-discovery adapters, so the same extraction route runs on real formats with `retrieved_mode` disclosed.
Jurisdiction and format overlays over the target lattice (materialize hot combinations only).
Baseline arms A1/A2 for the extraction benchmark - the first measured source-span-grounded-vs-free-form comparison.
Promotion gate run over the highest-reuse targets (party names, effective dates, monetary terms recur across nearly every document type).
Grow the reviewed `_SYNONYM_MAP` from the normalization-candidate queue - each accepted equivalence unlocks more multi-step chains. This is the highest-leverage way to raise the compose rate.
Connector/adapter primitives for the highest-demand gaps (the demo's nearest-producer hints name them) - e.g. an `entity_records_to_point_set` adapter to bridge resolution and spatial lanes.

Wire `primitives/mutators.py` in as ADAPTER EDGES: a deterministic mutator (field_rename, json_to_rows) can bridge two near-miss ports, so the compiler inserts a mutator step instead of declaring a gap.
Execute a compiled PlanLock end to end for a lane where working primitives exist (place-discovery), proving the compiled route runs, not just composes.

An LLM-in-the-loop arm: give the model only the compact edge cards + the compiler, and measure task success vs a baseline that reads source - the first direct test of "compile by edges beats rereading code".

Plug a real bounded model into `orderers.llm_propose`'s `propose` slot in a model-enabled environment; keep the validator/repair gate — measure how often the model's proposal validates first-try vs needs repair.
Grow the framework catalog per lane (SWE repair, RAG cite, detect-and-crop, dbt medallion) and let `framework_fill` compete with `deterministic_compile` on receipts.
Wire the ordering-strategy decision into the solve loop's execution path so the chosen strategy is recorded and the supervisor can promote the winner.
A real AST miner (`ast`/tree-sitter) behind the `ast_parse` acquisition path, runnable in a network-enabled environment, feeding real signatures into `form()`.
Import-smoke + fixture-behavior verification that earns real receipts (moving a mined primitive from `fixture_verified` to source-backed).
A per-source compose-rate lift metric (how many new routes a mined source unlocks) — the signal that says a source was worth mining.

Implement the deterministic AST miner (`scripts/mine_repo_primitives.py`) with the license/secret gate and the edge-typing step, runnable in a network-enabled environment; output candidate cards into a new lane pack.
Import-smoke + fixture verification harness so mined implemented-code primitives earn receipts (L4 -> L7).
Feed mined edges through `primitives/route_compiler.py` and log the compose rate lift per repo - the metric that says a repo was worth mining.
A private/tenant variant that mines internal repos into tenant-scoped primitives (never storing raw code; only edges + source-ref hashes), per the operating manual's private-repo factory.
`primitives/search.py` already indexes place-discovery cards; extend the index to this catalog so a CandidateBundle can span lanes (operating manual section 10).
Deterministic mutators (`primitives/mutators.py`) are the remix layer for resolved primitives - wire a `contract_diff_remix` that adapts a near-match resolved primitive to a requested edge.

Promote a first family from candidate to implemented: pick a high-reuse, low-risk family (e.g. a format-conversion primitive), implement it under `primitives/`, attach fixtures, and run it through the promotion gate (L0->L10). The catalog is the demand map; implementation is the wedge.
Source-adapter extraction (operating manual section 21): mine OpenAPI / MCP / package registries to turn real contracts into families automatically, instead of hand-authoring.
